deploymentAudit.cause: The deployment commit was rebased onto upstream native commits that landed between source freeze and push. classify-runtime-release-state.ps1 verifies deployment changes with -Staged, which reads the Git index (HEAD tree), not consensus.releaseTreeOid; HEAD therefore computed a different artifactSourceHash and buildIdentityHash than the promoted consensus.
deploymentAudit.resolution: Not repaired in place. Forcing a rewrite is forbidden and the later upstream train 54e249c524 deployed payload 82D7DA821DBCC860DAD87F74BF704E95D8661FB33D493873B79D03C5A3B8D94A (request DB14F01BAFBA7C9D0C1E875219356A749BBF309910B619EACBDC9EAC84068B0B) on top of the newer source, so this deployment is no longer the current runtime. The ordering constraint is now written into docs/runtime-build-reproducibility.md as an explicit invariant.

retainedFailures.detail: Tag runtime-build-v2/20261111-publisher-onboarding-aka-v1 was frozen before config/build/runtime-github-builder.v2.json.sourceRef was updated. The cloud workflow asserts sourceRef equals GITHUB_REF and the config is itself a policyHash input, so that tag could never obtain a cloud proof.
retainedFailures.resolution: Froze a second tag 20261111-publisher-onboarding-aka-v2 at a commit whose config names it; superseded request 34857398638CF4DC38D8A5F9AA13FCD7AC115A16269E1041E19F8B607EB74460. The v1 tag and its request remain immutable history, never dispatched and never promoted.

retainedFailures.detail: The first receipts for both release trees reported passed=false with four failing checks: guidance-tutorial-journeys (launcher/perf/node_modules/playwright missing), combat-fx-assets-current and combat-bullet-assets-current (tools/swf-audit/swfscan.py materialized CRLF while the catalog records the LF blob hash), shop-portrait-assets (37 data/shops/npcs/*.json were CRLF, 5 XFL XML were CRLF and 2 were mixed). Root cause: .gitattributes gained text eol=lf on 2026-11-08 but the working tree predates it, so Git considered the files clean and never rewrote the on-disk bytes.
retainedFailures.resolution: Installed the locked harness dependency with npm --prefix launcher/perf ci --ignore-scripts (documented command; the gate drives system Edge, no browser download). Re-materialized the 44 tracked text files with delete + git checkout so disk bytes equal the committed LF blobs. No catalog hash was regenerated and no blob changed; git status stayed clean and the release tree was unaffected. The four checks then passed and the full gate reported 47/47.

retainedFailures.resolution: Abandoned before requesting. No request, build, proof or promotion exists for this tag; running it would have rolled the live runtime back to an older tree. The tag remains immutable unused history.
